mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI inflation index above 334 signals rising inflationary pressures, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or inflation stabilizes without market reaction.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) coupled with falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a dual expansionary signal, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either proxy does not move in expected direction or combined effect fails to produce statistically significant positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 3.5%) create a favorable labor market and financial conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low unemployment and low rates regime
failure_condition: Either labor condition or monetary policy does not meet thresholds, or combined effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in demand measured by HOUST above 1500 units signals heightened economic activity, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the trigger occurring.

mechanism_narrative: An expansion in supply (INDPRO) alongside accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS decline) reduces production costs and boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: expanding supply and easing monetary policy
failure_condition: Either supply expansion or monetary easing does not occur, or combined effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in demand (GDPC1 above 24152.656) during a high-demand growth regime signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the demand threshold being crossed.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicate strong economic expansion, reducing production bottlenecks and enhancing corporate profits, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either demand or supply does not rise, or combined effect not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
